logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water partition coefficients (log P) were measured by using the shake-flask method as previously described [24]. A mixture of n-octanol and water was firstly shaken for 24 h continuously and separated by centrifugation for 20 min at 5000 r/min. Solutions (0.5 mM) of each compound in saturated n-octanol (water saturation) were shaken to balance. The maximum absorbance was read by UV spectrum (A0). Each solution was then vigorously mixed with an equal amount of water (n-octanol saturation). The UV spectrum of the n-octanol layer was determined after equilibration for 30 min (Ax). The partition coefficient (log P) was calculated according to the relationship, P = Ax /(A0-Ax).
